Grade: Grade 9 · Subject: GERMAN

[0:00–0:20] HOOK
• Host: “Today we learn Creative writing. Watch the example, then you try.”

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

[2:00–4:00] WORKED EXAMPLE ON SCREEN
• One clear model for Creative writing

[4:00–5:00] TRY THIS (PAUSE)
• Write 5 sentences.
• Do one oral practice with a partner.
• Correct spelling/punctuation.

[5:00–5:30] REMEMBER + CTA
• Recap 3 bullets. “Now open Revision Quiz for Creative writing.”
